description: This file defines TypeScript type declarations for the AbortController and AbortSignal interfaces, including global augmentations and related types in a Node.js environment.

classes.name: AbortController
classes.description: Interface representing a controller that can abort one or more DOM requests.

classes.name: AbortSignal
classes.description: Interface representing a signal object that allows you to communicate with a DOM request and abort it.

methods.name: abort(reason?: any): void; abort
methods.description: Method to abort the ongoing operation associated with the AbortController.

methods.name: throwIfAborted(): void; throwIfAborted
methods.description: Method to throw an error if the signal has been aborted.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Static method to combine multiple signals into one.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Static method to create a signal that will abort after a specified timeout.
